𝗛𝗲𝗮𝗱𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲: 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗙𝗮𝘆𝗲 𝗣𝗲𝗿𝗮𝘆𝗮 𝗘𝗳𝗳𝗲𝗰𝘁: 𝗔 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮-𝗕𝗮𝗰𝗸𝗲𝗱 𝗠𝗮𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗰𝗹𝗮𝘀𝘀 📉👑 

It’s one thing to see the crowds; it’s another to see the data. The results from FW26 Milan Fashion Week are in, and Faye Peraya @malisorn00 is officially in a league of her own.

𝑻𝒉𝒆 𝑩𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒌𝒅𝒐𝒘𝒏:

𝗚𝗹𝗼𝗯𝗮𝗹 #𝟭: Faye secured the top spot for individual “Voices,” generating a staggering $22.2M in MIV.

𝗜𝗺𝗽𝗮𝗰𝘁 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻: Her individual performance accounts for 31%+ of the total value of the Top 5 Celebrities combined.

𝗡𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗛𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗿𝘆: She was the primary driver behind Thailand’s historic lead over the Italian local market, personally contributing 17% of Thailand’s total $130.3M regional MIV.

We often talk about “influence,” but Faye is proving that a single, strategically positioned individual can rival the media reach of entire geographic regions. It’s not just about fashion; it’s about a global shift in digital power.

So proud to see Faye taking the world stage and rewriting the rules. 🇹🇭🕊️

@Ferragamo @FFabel_Ent @thisisnichapat 
#FayePeraya #MilanFashionWeek #MFW26
#FayeXFerragamo

Traffic Advisory 

In view of Navratra celebrations at Jhandewalan Mata Mandir (19–27 March 2026), heavy footfall may impact traffic on Rani Jhansi Road and DBG Road.

Traffic diversions may be implemented, commuters are advised to use Faiz Road and Panchkuian Road as alternate routes.

No illegal parking will be permitted around the temple premises.

Plan ahead, prefer public transport & follow traffic police directions.

#DPTrafficAdvisory

Traffic Advisory 

In view of Navratra celebrations at Kalkaji Mandir from 18–27 March 2026, heavy footfall is expected and traffic congestion is likely on Outer Ring Road, Maa Anandmai Marg, Captain Gaur Marg & Aastha Kunj Road. 

Commuters are advised to plan their journeys in advance, use alternate routes, and prefer public transport. 

Parking is prohibited on Outer Ring Road (Nehru Place to Modi Mill Flyover), and vehicles must be parked only in designated areas. 
Pedestrians are requested to use FOBs and avoid jaywalking.
